requests.title: Requests
requests.empty: No requests yet. Create a request to get started.
requests.no_matches: No requests match. Clear or adjust the filters.
requests.confirmed: Your latest change is confirmed by the server.
requests.not_confirmed: History refreshed; this change was not found. Check the list before trying again manually.
requests.reconcile_required: The outcome is unknown. Refresh history before trying again; automatic retries are disabled.
requests.form_intro: Submit a request for HR review
requests.pending_notice: Your request was submitted. Check its details for the current status.
requests.range_hint: Inclusive dates, up to 93 days; cannot begin before employment.
requests.range_invalid: Choose valid ordered dates covering at most 93 days.
requests.before_employment: Requests cannot begin before your employment start date.
requests.reason_invalid: Use 5–500 trimmed characters, or 0–120 for an Excuse.
requests.duration_invalid: Enter whole minutes from 1 to 1440, no longer than your assigned shift.
requests.schedule_required: Refresh your assigned schedule or contact HR before requesting an Excuse.
requests.excuse_allowance: All Excuse types share 240 minutes and at most 3 pending/approved requests per calendar month. Minutes apply to every date; cross-month requests count in each month. Withdrawal or final rejection releases reservations; a manager rejection alone does not. The server checks availability.
requests.deduction_policy: Current backend policy: HR approval returns 1 deduction day and rejection 3 for this request type. This includes Excuse, sick leave and missions. HR confirmation of this policy remains pending.
requests.attachment_hint: Optional: up to 3 PDF, PNG or JPEG files, at most 512 KiB each.
requests.attachment_invalid: Attachment unavailable or invalid. Use a valid PDF, PNG or JPEG up to 512 KiB.
requests.open_record_required: Select your own open attendance record. Refresh or contact HR if it is unavailable.
requests.departure_required: Choose the departure date and time.
requests.departure_invalid: Departure must be at or after check-in and in the past.
requests.forgotten_notice: Submitting this request leaves attendance open. Only HR approval records the corrected departure; it does not create photo evidence.
requests.timezone_notice: Choose the local departure time in {timezone}, regardless of your device timezone.
requests.nonexistent_time: This local time does not exist because the clocks changed. Choose another time.
requests.ambiguous_time: This local time occurs twice because the clocks changed. Choose its UTC occurrence.
requests.refresh_required: Unable to verify current profile, attendance or history. Refresh before submitting.
requests.stage_unknown: Manager stage unavailable for this historical record
requests.manager_notice: A manager recommendation is separate from HR’s final decision.
requests.withdraw_confirmation: Withdraw this pending request? It remains in history. To correct it, submit a replacement after withdrawal.
requests.correction_notice: Pending requests can be corrected by withdrawal and replacement. Approved requests require HR handling.
requests.unavailable: This request is no longer available in your current history.
requests.timezone_invalid: The saved timezone is unavailable. Contact HR.

attendance.no_matches: No records match. Clear or adjust the filters.
attendance.accuracy_distance: Accuracy: {accuracy} m · Distance from office: {distance} m
attendance.title: Attendance
attendance.capture_explanation: Take a fresh photo of your location and allow precise location access. You must be within {radius} m of the office, with GPS accuracy of {accuracy} m or better. The server verifies your evidence.
attendance.older_open: An attendance record from {date} is still open. Contact HR to correct it or request a forgotten check-out before starting a new workday.
attendance.completed: This workday is complete. Another check-in is unavailable.
attendance.history_limit: Up to 93 recorded intervals. This is not a complete calendar of absent days.
attendance.confirmed: The server confirms your attendance was recorded.
attendance.not_recorded: The server has no completed submission. You can retry with a fresh photo and location.
attendance.outcome_unknown: The submission outcome is unknown. Check it with the server before trying again.
attendance.saved_refresh_failed: Attendance was saved, but history could not be refreshed. Check the server before another submission.
attendance.phone_only: Use an Android or iOS phone to capture attendance.
attendance.location_off: Location services are off. Enable them in settings and retry.
attendance.location_blocked: Location access is blocked. Enable precise location access in app settings.
attendance.location_denied: Location permission is required. Retry and allow precise location access.
attendance.camera_denied: Camera access is blocked. Enable it in app settings and retry.
attendance.capture_failed: Camera capture is unavailable. Check camera access and retry.
attendance.location_timeout: A location fix could not be obtained. Move to a clear area and retry.
attendance.capture_expired: The evidence has expired. Take a new photo and location fix.
attendance.accuracy_low: GPS accuracy is insufficient. Enable precise location, move to a clear area and retry.
attendance.outside_office: Your measured location is outside the office radius. Move closer and retry.
attendance.photo_invalid: The camera photo could not be prepared as a supported image. Retake it.
attendance.photo_large: The photo exceeds the server size limit. Retake it.
